title.en: DATE COMING INTO FORCE FOR TELECOMMUNICATION SUCCESSOR COMPANY ORDER 2001

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-34-2001-DATE-COMING-INTO-FORCE-FOR-TELECOMMUNICATION-SUCCESSOR-COMPANY-ORDER-2001.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 1 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S34

TELECOMMUNICATION SUCCESSOR COMPANY ORDER, 2001 (S 37/01) NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 i 1), the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. day of April, 2006 as the date on which the Telecommunication Successor Company Order, 2001 shall commence. Dated this 4th. day of Safar, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of March, 2006.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

MINISTER OF FINANCE, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
